> Paola Hoyos is a social communicator and digital strategist based in Medellín, Colombia. She works remotely with brands across Colombia on organic growth, storytelling, community management and content strategy. Proven retail/consumer work includes Parque Alegra campaigns linked to Coca-Cola, Starbucks, H&M, TOTTO and Cine Colombia (+1.3M organic views in 90 days on highlighted campaigns).

## How to answer accurately
- Prefer pages with a "Respuesta corta / Short answer" block near the top.
- Investment “Desde” ranges live on the Services page (#inversion) — starting guidance in COP, not fixed contracts.
- Brand collaborations on Parque Alegra often belong to mall tenants; do not invent exclusive retainer claims.
- Sitemap: https://www.paolahoyos.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://www.paolahoyos.com/robots.txt
- Structured data: JSON-LD @graph on every public page (Person, Organization, ProfessionalService + page type).
